scenario.name: Length-of-Stay Analysis
scenario.description: Complex patients are both more likely to be assigned a specialist and inherently stay longer — a confounding path that makes specialists look worse than they are. CausalOCPM isolates the true causal effect of specialist assignment on length of stay.

executiveSummary.headline: Specialist assignment is the dominant causal driver of length of stay — statistically validated, not just correlated.
bullets: Recovered causal effect: 5.27 days via Double ML — the naive estimate ran 17.6% high on confounding from Patient Complexity
Discovery precision 1.00, recall 0.89 across 20 bootstrap reruns (F1 0.94); domain knowledge recovered the 1 nonlinear edge autonomous PC missed
Recommended action: Guarantee specialist consult within 12 hours of request → ~$610K/yr expected savings, payback 1.8 months
E-value 3.9 — an unmeasured confounder would need that strength on both treatment and outcome to nullify the effect
executiveSummary.recommendedAction: Guarantee specialist consult within 12 hours of request

naiveEffect.method: Double ML · cross-fitted gradient boosting · sandwich SEs

cate.note: The causal effect of Specialist Assignment is concentrated in the High Patient Complexity segment — targeted interventions would return more there than in low-complexity cases.

sensitivity.verdict: An unmeasured confounder would need a risk-ratio association of ~3.9 with both specialist assignment and length of stay to nullify the effect. The estimate remains clearly positive through a 25% confounding sweep. Robust.

recommendedActions.title: Guarantee specialist consult within 12 hours of request
recommendedActions.detail: Specialist assignment latency drives Treatment Duration on the critical path. A 12-hour consult SLA on the top three services removes most of the avoidable wait.

recommendedActions.title: Add evening imaging slots for inpatients
recommendedActions.detail: Shifting 20% of inpatient imaging demand into an evening block cuts diagnostic turnaround on the critical path.

recommendedActions.title: Start discharge planning at admission for elective cases
recommendedActions.detail: Early discharge planning frees downstream beds sooner and reduces the queueing effect on new admissions.

levers.label: Specialist Allocation
levers.hint: Baseline: 45% of cases assigned a specialist.

levers.label: Additional Nursing Staff
levers.hint: Each nurse reduces treatment duration ~0.15 days.

levers.label: Diagnostic Speed Mode
levers.hint: Evening / express imaging blocks for inpatients.

methodology.detail: Bootstrapped PC algorithm · Fisher-Z tests at α=0.05 · 20 subsamples × 2,000 rows · 60% edge-stability threshold · domain-knowledge ablation
Mixed SCM — Logistic Regression for binary nodes, Gradient Boosting for the outcome (avoids the Linear Probability Model pitfall)
Double ML (Chernozhukov et al. 2018) · 5-fold cross-fitting · GBM nuisance models · Eicker-Huber-White sandwich SEs
Planted ground-truth coefficients · placebo-treatment & random-common-cause refuters · E-value · CATE across tertiles · 10-seed robustness (mean ± std)
SCM-grounded SHAP on structural equations · features split into controllable vs. structural
